summary: Two hour platform outage stopped ticket intake at all four clinics
story: On the morning of September 14 our front desk could not open tickets in the FastFix desk from 9:20 to 11:20. The status page showed a platform outage in the US-West region, and FastFix confirmed it by email at 11:52. While the desk was down, one clinic could not log a fault with an X-ray unit, and our first response to that fault came the next morning, well after your eight business hour target. We are claiming the outage credit and the missed response credit.

items.description: Outage credit, two hours at $60 an hour
Missed response target, one service credit

documents.name: Status page incident report INC-4082
documents.content: FastFix IT Support status page, incident INC-4082. Started September 14, 2026 at 09:20, resolved at 11:20. Scope: Ticket Desk and FastFix Agent, US-West region. Cause: a failed database failover during a storage upgrade. Customer impact: tickets could not be opened or updated. A service credit applies under the support wording.

documents.name: FastFix confirmation email
documents.content: From: support@fastfix.example, September 14, 2026 at 11:52. To: Elena Marsh. We confirm that incident INC-4082 affected your desk from 09:20 to 11:20, two hours. We are sorry for the disruption. Your first response to ticket 8841 was sent on September 15 at 09:05, outside the eight business hour response target on your Standard plan.

summary: Five hour outage of the sync service halted warehouse label printing
story: On October 6 the sync service went down at 06:00 and came back at 11:00. Our two warehouses print shipping labels through the sync service, so both lines stopped for the whole morning shift. Your monitoring graph for our account shows the gap, and your own incident report names the sync service. Our Priority plan gives us a two hour response target around the clock, and the first engineer joined the ticket at 09:15, well past it. We are claiming the outage credit for the five hours and the missed response credit, and we expect the Priority multiplier on both.

items.description: Outage credit, five hours at $60 an hour
Missed response target, one service credit
